title: Concept: npm registry configured over cleartext
description: .npmrc declares a `registry` URL over cleartext, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a `registry` URL over cleartext.
risk: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a `registry` URL over cleartext.
